configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No capacity-dependent allocation; total execution budget declared for each sweep.
finding: Testing one default capacity misses index and fairness boundary defects.

title: Idle residency accounting
statement: CPU residency reports shall identify measured busy and idle intervals without counting blocked host simulation time as target execution.
rationale: Existing metrics need a calibrated interpretation before they support performance claims.
acceptance: A controlled idle-heavy workload and busy loop produce ordered residency results; totals reconcile within declared sampling error.
verification: Compare target counter accounting with external GPIO intervals and explicit sampling overhead.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Accounting work is constant per transition; error ceiling declared in target counter units.
finding: Existing metrics need a calibrated interpretation before they support performance claims.

title: Reproducible optimized builds
statement: Qualified firmware and interpreter builds shall record effective compiler options and require the designated optimized profile to use -O3.
rationale: Requested optimization must be verified from effective commands rather than preset names.
acceptance: A substituted -O2 interpreter or wrong language standard rejects the optimized qualification label.
verification: Inspect compilation databases and embedded build identity; execute a wrong-flags negative fixture.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: C++20 interpreter; -O3 release profile; debug and sanitizer profiles remain separately named.
finding: Requested optimization must be verified from effective commands rather than preset names.

title: Performance regression envelope
statement: The performance gate shall compare fixed workloads only under matching hardware, compiler, features and measurement methods.
rationale: An observed speed difference is meaningless when build or measurement conditions change.
acceptance: Changed profile identities prevent direct speedup claims; a seeded slow-path injection crosses and fails the recorded threshold.
verification: Retain baseline distributions, repetitions, machine identity and confidence method alongside raw observations.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Per-workload threshold and repeat count fixed before candidate execution.
finding: An observed speed difference is meaningless when build or measurement conditions change.

title: Optional lifecycle compatibility
statement: A future lifecycle profile shall use boot-reserved thread slots while preserving sealed registration and permanent completion in the default profile.
rationale: Runtime lifetime support need not imply dynamic allocation but must not silently alter the current contract.
acceptance: Default post-start create still fails; lifecycle-disabled binaries expose no runtime recycling path.
verification: Compile both profiles and execute default registration regressions plus opt-in slot state fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed slot and stack pool; zero general heap; lifecycle remains opt-in.
finding: Runtime lifetime support need not imply dynamic allocation but must not silently alter the current contract.

title: Thread generation exhaustion
statement: A recyclable thread handle shall contain a generation that never wraps into a previously valid handle during a boot.
rationale: Index-only handles would allow stale commands to control a different thread incarnation.
acceptance: An old handle fails after slot reuse; the final representable generation exhausts the slot rather than wrapping.
verification: Use a reduced-width generation fixture and validate real-width boundary arithmetic.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One generation word per reserved slot; exhausted slots remain unavailable until reset.
finding: Index-only handles would allow stale commands to control a different thread incarnation.

title: Cooperative stop acknowledgement
statement: A stop request shall be acknowledged as complete only after the worker reaches a documented safe point and settles owned resources.
rationale: Setting a stop flag is not evidence that a worker is safe to reuse.
acceptance: A worker retaining a mutex or DMA ownership cannot report stopped; a safe worker acknowledges once.
verification: Pause workers at each ownership transition and issue duplicate stop requests.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One stop flag and acknowledgement per permanent worker; finite grace deadline.
finding: Setting a stop flag is not evidence that a worker is safe to reuse.

title: Thread join evidence
statement: An optional join operation shall distinguish running, completed, timed-out and stale generations without consuming another incarnation's completion.
rationale: The current finished state is not a join or storage-reclamation protocol.
acceptance: Two joiners observe the documented policy; timeout and completion races never return an unrelated generation.
verification: Enumerate completion-before-wait, wait-before-completion and timeout boundaries in a state model.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed join waiter capacity; no allocation and no infinite cleanup scan.
finding: The current finished state is not a join or storage-reclamation protocol.

title: Thread reclamation barrier
statement: A lifecycle slot shall become reusable only after all scheduler, waiter, observer and ownership references to its old generation are retired.
rationale: Thread completion alone cannot prove that all kernel references are gone.
acceptance: Attempt reuse with one stale waiter or pending observer reference and receive a bounded refusal.
verification: Inject each retained reference separately and verify no stack or control-block overwrite.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Reference metadata bounded by configured threads and waiters; no runtime stack growth.
finding: Thread completion alone cannot prove that all kernel references are gone.

title: Abandoned mutex policy
statement: The lifecycle API shall reject normal reclamation of a thread that still owns a mutex and report the ownership violation.
rationale: Releasing a dead owner's lock can expose partially updated application state.
acceptance: Exit or stop with one and multiple owned mutexes produces the declared fault without silently transferring protected data.
verification: Exercise nested ownership and inherited priority chains with an independent ownership ledger.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No forced unlock; reporting bounded by configured owned-mutex metadata.
finding: Releasing a dead owner's lock can expose partially updated application state.

title: Cancellation wait removal
statement: An optional cancellation path shall remove exactly the cancelled generation's pending wait under the same serialization as grant and timeout.
rationale: A second terminal path can duplicate grants unless it shares the existing wait arbitration.
acceptance: Grant, timeout and cancel permutations yield one terminal result and conserve queue items and semaphore tokens.
verification: Exhaustively model finite interleavings and run seeded target races.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: At most configured waiter scans; no callback or device access inside the wait lock.
finding: A second terminal path can duplicate grants unless it shares the existing wait arbitration.

title: Lifecycle priority cleanup
statement: Slot reuse shall discard inherited priority and donation links from the retired generation before publishing the new thread.
rationale: Donation metadata belongs to an incarnation rather than a reusable storage address.
acceptance: A reused low-priority thread cannot inherit a prior owner's donated priority or remain in its chain.
verification: Build chained donation fixtures and reuse each retired slot position.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Cleanup bounded by configured mutex and thread counts.
finding: Donation metadata belongs to an incarnation rather than a reusable storage address.

title: Worker activation conservation
statement: Permanent-worker test jobs shall use unique run and job identities and reject activation while the prior job is unsettled.
rationale: Boot-created workers already support repeated jobs without promising runtime thread creation.
acceptance: Duplicate activation executes once; a new run cannot consume a queued old-run command.
verification: Use a bounded command queue with replayed commands and delayed acknowledgements.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One active job per worker and a fixed outstanding command window.
finding: Boot-created workers already support repeated jobs without promising runtime thread creation.

title: Lifecycle fault recovery boundary
statement: Lifecycle failure shall distinguish recoverable quiescence from a reset-required ownership domain.
rationale: A cleanup timeout does not establish that hardware or kernel references have stopped.
acceptance: A cooperative timeout with unsettled DMA reports reset required and never permits slot or buffer reuse.
verification: Inject failed stop and incomplete resource release and verify the reset policy against observed accesses.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No automatic force-delete; finite stop deadline and retained first failure.
finding: A cleanup timeout does not establish that hardware or kernel references have stopped.

title: Independent RISC-V feature matrix
statement: Qualification shall build baseline, Zaamo-only, M/U-PMP-only and combined profiles as four independent configurations.
rationale: Atomics and privilege protection are separate axes and should not become one coupled feature.
acceptance: Each profile reports its actual ISA and privilege capability; disabling either extension preserves baseline behavior.
verification: Compile and execute profile-specific positive and illegal-operation fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Single hart; fixed four-region PMP profile where enabled; no implicit MMU.
finding: Atomics and privilege protection are separate axes and should not become one coupled feature.

title: Zaamo capability mismatch
statement: The platform shall reject an atomic-capable build when the selected execution target or RAM window lacks the required Zaamo contract.
rationale: Instruction availability alone does not establish atomic behavior for every mapped address.
acceptance: Wrong-capability manifests fail before workload release; baseline fallback uses its explicitly selected implementation.
verification: Run manifest mismatch controls and RAM versus MMIO atomic address fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No atomics on device memory; no silent runtime emulation inside the hardware qualification profile.
finding: Instruction availability alone does not establish atomic behavior for every mapped address.

title: Atomic return-value oracle
statement: Zaamo qualification shall check both stored values and returned old values for every supported operation.
rationale: Final memory checks can miss an incorrect register result from an atomic instruction.
acceptance: Exchange, add, OR and AND return and store the expected words; signed min and max are tested only when separately advertised by the instruction model.
verification: Execute edge operands and randomized word pairs; mutate return-value handling to prove detection.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed operand corpus plus declared seed and operation count; no heap on target.
finding: Final memory checks can miss an incorrect register result from an atomic instruction.

title: Atomic ordering witnesses
statement: Atomic memory ordering claims shall be limited to the declared single-hart interrupt and device-ordering model.
rationale: A single-hart stress pass cannot establish multicore memory-order semantics.
acceptance: Release-acquire publication under preemption succeeds; unsupported multicore ordering is reported unsupported.
verification: Run interrupt handoff litmus tests and inspect emitted fences with the selected compiler.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No SMP qualification claim; bounded shared ordinary-RAM words.
finding: A single-hart stress pass cannot establish multicore memory-order semantics.

title: User entry register sanitation
statement: An optional U-mode entry shall initialize privilege state and all exposed register contents according to a documented ABI.
rationale: Processor U-mode support does not by itself supply a safe operating-system user boundary.
acceptance: Entry cannot inherit privileged stack pointers or stale kernel data; legal user entry reaches its declared PC.
verification: Use register-pattern fixtures and inspect mstatus, mepc and return privilege on an independent execution model.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One declared user frame per slot; no FP or vector state unless separately enabled.
finding: Processor U-mode support does not by itself supply a safe operating-system user boundary.

title: PMP boundary access matrix
statement: Four-region PMP qualification shall test the last allowed and first forbidden byte for every configured access permission.
rationale: Region setup needs boundary evidence rather than only checking CSR readback.
acceptance: Read, write and execute violations trap with the expected cause and address; permitted boundary accesses succeed.
verification: Generate byte, halfword and word probes including region-crossing accesses on RTL and interpreter.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Exactly four declared regions; reject unrepresentable layouts before enabling user execution.
finding: Region setup needs boundary evidence rather than only checking CSR readback.

title: PMP lock semantics
statement: PMP lock qualification shall verify the documented reset-only unlock behavior and machine-mode access effects.
rationale: A simulated region table can miss architectural lock effects and their reset lifetime.
acceptance: Writes to locked configuration fail to change it; accesses obey the selected locked permissions until reset.
verification: Attempt configuration and address rewrites and compare reset and pre-reset behavior.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: No runtime unlock API; fixed board reset domain.
finding: A simulated region table can miss architectural lock effects and their reset lifetime.

title: Trap origin integrity
statement: Trap dispatch shall preserve and report the originating privilege mode without allowing user-controlled state to impersonate kernel origin.
rationale: Shared trap entry must distinguish a legitimate user request from a kernel exception.
acceptance: User ecall and illegal CSR access are classified correctly; nested fault fixtures retain original context evidence.
verification: Compare saved status and cause against independently calculated trap transitions.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed trap frames; bounded nesting policy explicitly declared.
finding: Shared trap entry must distinguish a legitimate user request from a kernel exception.

title: Interpreter timer service modes
statement: The interpreter shall separate instruction-exact timer delivery from opt-in batched delivery and report the configured delay bound.
rationale: Reducing timer checks can improve throughput while changing interrupt placement and must be visible.
acceptance: Batch size one agrees with exact delivery; batch size ten never exceeds its declared instruction delay in eligible execution.
verification: Use known-deadline instruction streams, branch loops and masked-interrupt cases with reference traces.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Batch parameter finite and recorded; no timing-accuracy label for relaxed delivery.
finding: Reducing timer checks can improve throughput while changing interrupt placement and must be visible.

title: Interpreter RTL differential trace
statement: Instruction-model qualification shall compare architectural retire state with RTL for matched finite workloads.
rationale: Fast interpretation needs an independent oracle rather than self-comparison of final signatures.
acceptance: Register, PC, trap cause and touched memory first diverge at a recorded instruction identity; an injected opcode defect is detected.
verification: Run short deterministic instruction, atomic and privilege corpora with identical reset state.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Bounded trace window and operation count; model speed does not imply cycle accuracy.
finding: Fast interpretation needs an independent oracle rather than self-comparison of final signatures.

title: Random stream versioning
statement: Randomized tests shall identify the generator algorithm and version as well as the seed and stream identifier.
rationale: A seed alone cannot reproduce a test after the generator or stream partition changes.
acceptance: A golden vector reproduces across host and target builds; changing the algorithm without changing version fails.
verification: Publish fixed seed vectors including zero and maximal seeds and compare independent implementations.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed generator state per worker; no entropy dependency for replay.
finding: A seed alone cannot reproduce a test after the generator or stream partition changes.

title: Schedule choice recording
statement: Replay reports shall distinguish deterministic workload inputs from nondeterministic interrupt and scheduling choices.
rationale: Seeded jobs are reproducible even when their legal thread interleavings are not.
acceptance: Identical seeds with different timer delivery produce separate schedule identities; exact replay is claimed only with sufficient recorded choices.
verification: Repeat workloads with shifted interrupt points and compare input and schedule logs separately.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed trace ring with explicit loss counters; loss disables exact replay claims.
finding: Seeded jobs are reproducible even when their legal thread interleavings are not.

title: Job oracle independence
statement: Each randomized job family shall have a reference calculation that does not reuse the tested implementation path.
rationale: A checksum of the implementation's own answer is not an independent correctness oracle.
acceptance: A deliberate error in arithmetic, queue ordering or payload generation yields a mismatch even with a valid transport CRC.
verification: Use separately authored reference functions and mutation fixtures for each job family.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed input and result sizes; bounded outstanding jobs.
finding: A checksum of the implementation's own answer is not an independent correctness oracle.

title: Replay bundle completeness
statement: A replay bundle shall include firmware, source revision, dirty diff, tool versions, configuration, seed and the terminal classification.
rationale: A commit ID cannot identify uncommitted source or substituted firmware bytes.
acceptance: Removing any mandatory identity makes the bundle incomplete; a clean and dirty build remain distinguishable.
verification: Validate bundle schema against intentionally missing fields and hash mismatches.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Host storage quota declared per run; archive exhaustion cannot be reported as a pass.
finding: A commit ID cannot identify uncommitted source or substituted firmware bytes.

title: First-fault retention scope
statement: Fault reports shall state whether their storage survives only the current boot or a qualified reset domain.
rationale: The current FirstFault helper explicitly does not provide reset or double-fault retention.
acceptance: Ordinary RAM is never labeled reset-retained; a later fault cannot overwrite the first fault in the same capture epoch.
verification: Trigger two distinct faults and then each supported reset kind; compare retained identity and validity markers.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One fixed first-fault record per capture epoch; no allocation in capture.
finding: The current FirstFault helper explicitly does not provide reset or double-fault retention.

title: Trace overflow semantics
statement: Trace consumers shall report lost events and forbid complete-history conclusions after overflow.
rationale: A bounded trace is useful evidence only when omitted history remains explicit.
acceptance: Fill the ring, drop events, drain and refill; loss count is visible and saturates without wrapping.
verification: Exercise capacity one, full and counter-boundary fixtures and malformed consumer sequence claims.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Configured event capacity only; overflow never blocks producers.
finding: A bounded trace is useful evidence only when omitted history remains explicit.

title: Failure minimization preservation
statement: A failure reducer shall preserve the original bundle and emit every reduced candidate as a separately identified artifact.
rationale: Simplifying a randomized failure can accidentally remove the trigger while retaining a similar symptom.
acceptance: A reduced workload that stops reproducing is rejected as a reproducer; original inputs remain immutable.
verification: Replay a seeded injected failure, remove operations and verify stable failure identity.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Finite reduction attempts and host time budget; no autonomous unbounded search.
finding: Simplifying a randomized failure can accidentally remove the trigger while retaining a similar symptom.

title: Mismatch first witness
statement: A result mismatch shall retain the first worker, job sequence, operation and expected versus observed value before summarizing signatures.
rationale: Aggregate mismatch counts do not identify the operation needed to reproduce a defect.
acceptance: Two mismatches preserve the earliest witness; report truncation cannot erase its identity.
verification: Inject a known bad job followed by a second fault and saturate normal telemetry.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One fixed witness record plus bounded context window.
finding: Aggregate mismatch counts do not identify the operation needed to reproduce a defect.

title: Endurance completion criteria
statement: An endurance result shall require its declared target operations and target duration independently of host cutoff.
rationale: A twelve-hour host window does not imply twelve hours of simulated target execution.
acceptance: A host deadline reached before target goals reports wall limit or incomplete rather than passed.
verification: Run deliberately slow simulation with short host cutoff and a separate completed control.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Finite host cutoff plus cleanup allowance; target goals recorded before start.
finding: A twelve-hour host window does not imply twelve hours of simulated target execution.

title: Detection qualification campaign
statement: Each claimed invariant checker shall detect at least one controlled violation of its own property.
rationale: Healthy runs alone cannot demonstrate that diagnostic checks discriminate failures.
acceptance: Disabled or always-successful checkers fail qualification; every injected violation has an expected classification.
verification: Create explicit controls for context corruption, duplicate jobs, stale handles and bad UART content.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fault injection confined to named test profiles; no release default activation.
finding: Healthy runs alone cannot demonstrate that diagnostic checks discriminate failures.

title: Fixed-frame wire schema
statement: The HIL codec shall encode the documented 512-byte frame using explicit little-endian fields and zero padding.
rationale: The wire proposal exists but no frozen executable codec currently establishes compatibility.
acceptance: Golden frames match byte for byte on host and target; native struct packing changes do not alter encoding.
verification: Cross-check independent encoders and a published offset table including all boundary fields.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: 512 decoded bytes: 40 header, 468 payload region and 4 CRC bytes.
finding: The wire proposal exists but no frozen executable codec currently establishes compatibility.

title: CRC coverage controls
statement: The codec shall validate CRC-32C over all first 508 decoded bytes including padding before dispatch.
rationale: Validating only meaningful payload would leave framing metadata and padding unchecked.
acceptance: Single-bit changes in header, payload and padding fail; the standard check string yields E3069283.
verification: Use independent bitwise and optimized implementations plus fixed known-answer frames.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Four-byte little-endian CRC; polynomial 82F63B78 with declared initial and final XOR.
finding: Validating only meaningful payload would leave framing metadata and padding unchecked.

title: COBS resynchronization bounds
statement: The decoder shall bound encoded accumulation and recover at a delimiter after malformed or oversized input.
rationale: USB and serial read boundaries do not correspond to logical frame boundaries.
acceptance: All-zero payload and maximal nonzero runs round-trip; oversized or truncated frames never grow storage or dispatch commands.
verification: Feed arbitrary read fragments, consecutive delimiters and corrupted code bytes followed by a valid frame.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: At most 516 encoded bytes including delimiter; statically reserved 576-byte slots.
finding: USB and serial read boundaries do not correspond to logical frame boundaries.

title: Packet rejection ordering
statement: Packet validation shall reject magic, version, reserved fields, length and CRC errors before command side effects.
rationale: A checksum pass is insufficient to authorize a structurally invalid command.
acceptance: Each malformed field independently causes rejection and leaves run state, output ownership and command cache unchanged.
verification: Compare state snapshots around one-field mutations and wrong-endian fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Constant frame ceiling; no payload-dependent allocation or callback before validation.
finding: A checksum pass is insufficient to authorize a structurally invalid command.

title: Session and boot identity binding
statement: Every state-changing command shall match the negotiated session nonce and current boot identity.
rationale: Sequence numbers alone cannot isolate sessions across reboot and USB enumeration.
acceptance: A captured pre-reset command and a command from another host session cannot start or stop work.
verification: Replay frames across reconnection and controlled resets with unchanged command numbers.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: 128-bit session nonce and 64-bit boot identity per wire proposal; entropy quality stated separately.
finding: Sequence numbers alone cannot isolate sessions across reboot and USB enumeration.

title: Command retry idempotency
statement: The target shall return a cached response for an exact retry of the last command without repeating side effects.
rationale: Transport retries need execution identity rather than blind re-dispatch of commands.
acceptance: Duplicate START and STOP execute once; reuse of the same command ID with different bytes is rejected.
verification: Drop the first response, resend identical and modified requests and count actual state transitions.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: One command in flight; one bounded request-response cache.
finding: Transport retries need execution identity rather than blind re-dispatch of commands.

title: Transport sequence interpretation
statement: The receiver shall distinguish transport loss and duplicate frames from logical report or command identity.
rationale: Transport sequencing and logical event deduplication solve different problems.
acceptance: A repeated fault report with a new transport sequence is not a new fault; missing transport sequence increments loss evidence.
verification: Inject reordered, duplicate and wrapping transport sequences with stable logical identities.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Fixed tracking window and documented sequence wrap comparison.
finding: Transport sequencing and logical event deduplication solve different problems.

title: Status paging coherence
statement: Paged status shall carry a sample epoch and page bounds so a host never merges incompatible snapshots.
rationale: A single 512-byte packet cannot hold an unbounded worker inventory.
acceptance: More than eight workers are reported over pages; a changed epoch during collection invalidates the aggregate.
verification: Mutate worker counters between pages and test missing, duplicate and out-of-range pages.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Eight 32-byte thread slots per status frame; bounded page count declared by profile.
finding: A single 512-byte packet cannot hold an unbounded worker inventory.

title: Capability validity encoding
statement: Optional telemetry fields shall carry explicit validity and capability metadata rather than treating zero as unsupported.
rationale: Zero measurements can otherwise create false claims about unavailable hardware features.
acceptance: A supported zero-error ECC counter differs from absent ECC hardware; unsupported latency does not display as zero latency.
verification: Round-trip absent, valid-zero, saturated and stale metrics in schema fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Validity bits and typed units fit the fixed schema; no implicit feature inference.
finding: Zero measurements can otherwise create false claims about unavailable hardware features.

title: Protocol compatibility negotiation
statement: Handshake shall reject incompatible major schemas and negotiate only documented compatible capabilities before CONFIGURE.
rationale: Version numbers need an explicit compatibility rule before mixed host and firmware builds are safe.
acceptance: Unknown mandatory features and incompatible packet layout fail without arming workers; optional unknown fields follow the stated policy.
verification: Run old/new schema fixture pairs and unsupported-command probes.
configuration: Opt-in qualification profile; boot-static storage; single CPU unless explicitly qualified otherwise.
resource_budget: Bounded capability bitmap and finite handshake deadline.
finding: Version numbers need an explicit compatibility rule before mixed host and firmware builds are safe.
